scheduling.summary: CCM Standing Orders establish General and Streamlined Case Track deadlines. Individual versions linked on profile. Extraction gap: CCM PDF pages 1-2 (likely the main deadlines table) not text-extractable.
scheduling.evidence: Summary Judgment Order (Oct 4, 2023) sets: SJ motions filed/served no later than 60 days before trial; all other motions filed/served no later than 30 days before Pretrial Conference; no motion heard at or after pretrial conference absent compelling circumstances and consent of the Court.

conferral_motion_hearing.summary: Within 20 days of filing any motion for which a hearing is requested, moving party must contact the presiding judge's office to set the motion for hearing; failure may result in denial.
conferral_motion_hearing.source: CCM Standing Order (both tracks), Additional Requirements paragraph 1, page 3 of 4
conferral_motion_hearing.quote:
Within 20 days of filing any motion for which a hearing is requested, the
moving party must contact the presiding judge's office to set the motion for hearing. Failure 
to seek such hearing may result in the motion being denied.

submissions_certification.summary: Within 30 days of entry of the Standing Order (Plaintiff) or filing an appearance (Defendant), counsel or pro se party must file a certification of having read and agreed to the Standing Order and the presiding judge's Administrative Procedures on www.jud14.flcourts.org.
submissions_certification.source: CCM Standing Order (both tracks), Additional Requirements paragraph 2, page 3 of 4
submissions_certification.quote:
Within thirty (30) days of entry of this Standing Order for Plaintiff, and within
thirty (30) days of filing an appearance in this case for each Defendant/Third-Party Defendant, 
counsel, or the party if pro se, shall file a certification that they have read and agree to abide 
by this Standing Order and the presiding judge's Administrative Procedures, which may be 
found on the 14th Judicial Circuit's website, www.jud14.flcourts.org.
